home.introTitle: Reliable concrete solutions from day one
home.introText: We specialise in concrete works for airports and heavy infrastructure. With a focus on precision, durability and compliance with international standards, we deliver solutions that last — even under the harshest conditions.

about.title: About Infra-Beton ApS
about.text1: Infra-Beton ApS is a Danish concrete company based in Aabenraa. We carry out concrete works for demanding aviation and infrastructure projects where the requirements for quality and documentation are high.
about.text2: Our core competence is airport-related concrete works — including sealing and renovation of runways, taxiways and aprons. We work to international aviation standards and collaborate closely with clients and consultants throughout the entire project.
about.text3: We are a smaller, specialised company, which means short decision paths, direct communication and personal responsibility for the quality of every single project.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive concrete solutions for projects of every size
services.service1Text: Supply and installation of concrete elements for infrastructure projects. We work with prefabricated solutions tailored to each project's specific requirements for load capacity and durability.
services.service2Text: Specialised sealing and renovation of concrete surfaces at airports — runways, taxiways and aprons. We work in accordance with international aviation standards and are used to operating under strict safety and documentation requirements.
services.service3Text: Concrete works for larger infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges and industrial facilities. We take on assignments that require technical expertise and the ability to work under complex conditions.
